notes.title: Oh yeah! First Update, Baby! A Ton of Epic Stuff Awaits!
notes.notes: [p]We’re kicking things off with a massive first update! New dangers, loot, and pure adrenaline are calling your name! Ready to dive in? Check out what’s new: New Obstacles:[/p][list][*][p]Poison Mushroom – Safe to approach, but use it to coat your weapon with deadly poison for some nasty surprises![/p][/*][*][p]Brown Mushroom – Tough as nails and hiding a secret. Tread carefully![/p][/*][/list][p]Awesome New Features:[/p][list][*][p]Rewards! Grab cards, gold, and gear – everything you love![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455321/c5077c8e6a588c63060fd2b36e3f2229d38689d8.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Inventory! Equip swords, cloaks, axes, and boots – become a true legend! Check out the full arsenal on our X community![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455321/f31e2fdca8aa733f826eeff2b99c63f8d657fe97.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Global Map! Choose your path, conquer challenges, and carve your way to glory![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455321/4cd7721ce407047d410fcdfe5bfc697b358445df.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]New Cards:[/p][list][*][p]Execution – The more attack cards you play, the deadlier your strike. Wipe out your foes![/p][p]Might – Smash enemies so hard they fly back a tile with crushing damage![/p][/*][*][p]Poisoned Weapon – Use the poison mushroom to coat your weapon and deal lingering damage to enemies over time.[/p][/*][*][p]Piece of Brown Mushroom – Break off a chunk, eat it, and become nearly invincible! Effect lasts 3 turns but fades gradually.[/p][/*][/list][p]New Enemies:[/p][list][*][p]Elven Archer – Fast, deadly with a bow, but fragile. Catch her if you can![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455321/9981e0e15433b70be8845c35755125af3a9f5ef9.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Treant – Slow, hits like a truck, and knocks you back. Good luck taking down this beast![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455321/2e6ccf7421081e5cdc53a974c13f93af04e4f33c.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]Eyes sparkling? Wanna see it in action? Jump into our X community, follow us, stay in the loop, and dive into the game! Share your thoughts in the reviews – we wanna hear what you think![/p]
